Year-end Ingria strip and Smolensk-Seversk to the Commonwealth match Cliopatria, but the ledger gave Sweden the whole of Leningrad oblast (360 cells) in 1617-1618 and the 1619 snap undid it; patched.

Ottoman/Safavid/Caucasus frontier matches Cliopatria; the Iraqi western desert (about 795 cells) goes unowned in 1612 with no event after 1609-1611 held all of Iraq (patched); thin grey slivers on the frontier, about 40 cells, left.
Ming, Later Jin, Liaodong occupation hatch and Joseon look right; the Tumed 200 km disc bites into Ming Shanxi (settled by p1600-p1609 rulings/0, 32 cells of Inner Mongolia and Shaanxi remain Tumed).
Toungoo, Lan Na vassal, Ayutthaya, Lan Xang and Cambodia look right; fine as drawn.
Rajput vassals tinted under the Mughals, Mewar a vassal from 1615; Bikaner State drawn as a ring with a Mughal-owned hole of 97 cells at its centre (patched).
After patch: Denmark-Norway red, Swedish Ingria a limited strip with Russia holding the east of Leningrad oblast.
After patch: all of Iraq Ottoman in 1612 as in 1609-1611.

issues.what: Sweden drawn with the whole of Leningrad oblast (360 cells, Tikhvin, Ladoga, Lodeynoye Pole included) in 1617-1618, then snapped back in 1619 (swedish-empire_1619 removed 282, Russia added 245). The gazetteer's Ingria region is the whole oblast (388 cells); Cliopatria's Swedish shape of 1619 holds 95 Ingria cells (24,000 km2).

Truce of Deulino: the dossiers hand the Commonwealth the whole gazetteer Chernigov region (417 cells with all of Kursk and most of Bryansk oblast) at the end of 1618; the 1619 snap takes about 216 cells back. Cliopatria's 1619 Commonwealth shape holds 186 of them. Russia now keeps the rest through 1618 and 1619.

Ottoman Empire loses the Iraqi west (Al-Anbar 352, Al-Muthannia 142, An-Najaf 101 and about 200 more cells) in 1612 with no event, though its own 1609 keyframe and its 1624-1625 ledger losses treat all of Iraq as Ottoman until the Safavid capture of Baghdad on 14 January 1624.
Bikaner State drawn as a ring: 97 cells at the centre of its 140 km disc are Mughal-owned (present in the 1600 anchor already, from the 16th century windows).

Denmark-Norway (all 2,934 cells, Norway included) drawn as a vassal of the Duchy of Holstein since 1523, from duchy-of-holstein ledger/3 (vassal_start with counterpart denmark-norway). The published draft shows it; the p1500-p1599 patch (events/0) closes the relation in 1526, so the final compile is right, and a patch of my own would only have added a spurious caption.

Ming/Tumed 1619: the Tumed 200 km disc round Hohhot overlaps 134 Ming cells (Shanxi 102, Inner Mongolia 23, Shaanxi 9). With p1600-p1609 rulings/0 the Shanxi part is already Ming and 32 cells remain Tumed by the size rule; a ruling of mine settled nothing and was dropped.

Time of Troubles hole: 545 cells of Tver (225), Kaluga (116), Orel (108), Tula (42) and Moscow oblast (54) are unowned in 1610-1611 (Cliopatria's 1609 Russian shape dips; the 1612 shape restores them). The page puts False Dmitry II's base at Kaluga and says he 'recovered a hold over all of south-eastern Russia' in 1610, but it does not mention Tula, Orel or Tver.

Ottoman/Safavid 1612 conflict (97 cell-years after the other windows' patches: Al Jahrah in Kuwait 31, Iğdir 15, West Azarbaijan 14, Ağrı 8): the Safavids win by the size rule. No page opened covers Kuwait or the Ararat frontier in 1612.
Mewar/Mughal 1612 (60 cells), Hunza and Nagar/Mughal 1612 (53) and Kangra/Mughal 1612 (27): the smaller, independent state wins; Mewar becomes a Mughal vassal in February 1615 as its ledger says.

Tsardom of Russia 1619 snap (added 900, removed 622 after the patch: Krasnoyarsk 463 in, 574 out, Tomsk, Kemerovo): the Yeniseysk disc of the ledger against Cliopatria's Siberian shape; the dossier already says the shape is the better outline.
Bohemian Confederacy/Moravia 1619 (54 cells in Vysočina and Pardubický): Moravia wins by size on a historical border strip.

Later Jin 1619 snap (added 297, Jilin 243), Spanish Empire 1612 snap (Georgia and Florida, 108 cells), Ahmadnagar 1619 snap (110) and the Toungoo/Ayutthaya events of 1613-1618: plausible in the picture, not checked against pages.

dossier_requests.what: Ledger/3 (6 June 1523, vassal_start, counterpart denmark-norway) makes Denmark-Norway the vassal of Holstein; replace it by a relation the other way round (Holstein under the Danish crown) or delete it together with ledger/5.
dossier_requests.why: The compile tints all 2,934 cells of Denmark-Norway (Norway included) as a vassal of Holstein from 1526. p1500-p1599 events/0 closes it from 1526, so the dossier fix only removes the dependence on that patch.

dossier_requests.what: No dossier for the pretender's lands of the Time of Troubles (Tushino camp 1608-1610, Kaluga base to December 1610) and nothing owns central Russia's 545 cells in 1610-1611.
dossier_requests.why: Page: 'the second False Dmitry fled from Tushino ... to his base at Kaluga' and he 'recovered a hold over all of south-eastern Russia'; Tula, Orel and Tver are not named, so the extent needs a page the orchestrator chooses. Alternative: a tsardom-of-russia keyframe override for 1609 (p1600-p1609's window) giving the dip back to Russia.

problems: Gazetteer: region 'Ingria' is the whole of Leningrad oblast (388 cells, 98,000 km2) and region 'Chernigov' is Bryansk + Chernihiv + Kursk oblast (417 cells); both are used by dossier events (swedish-empire/ledger/6, tsardom-of-russia ledger/48 and the 1617 keyframe, polish-lithuanian-commonwealth ledger/20, tsardom-of-russia ledger/49). Narrowing them in regions.jsonl would make events/0-3 and keyframe_overrides/0 unnecessary.

Boundary: keyframe_overrides/1 (ottoman-empire_1612) holds for 1612-1625, so p1620-p1629 sees all of Iraq Ottoman until the ledger losses of 1624-1625 (Baghdad, then 'Iraq minus Baghdad', which now also take the western desert). No entry is dated outside 1610-1619.
Boundary: Ming keyframes of 1622-1640 may recreate the Tumed overlap in later windows (p1600-p1609 rulings/0 covers only 1600-1609); after the p1600 ruling the 1619 overlap is 32 cells.

Dating: Deulino is 11 December 1618 in tsardom-of-russia/ledger/49 and 4 January 1619 (took effect) in polish-lithuanian-commonwealth/ledger/20; my events/2-3 fix the extent, not the date, so Russia's own event still moves the land in December 1618.

Dossier edits since the published compile (swedish-ingria now owns 72 cells as a colony, 69 cell-years of R2 conflict with Russia in 1619; duchy-of-pomerania conflicts) change the packet; the stage trial and the published draft therefore differ beyond my patch.

hierarchy: (unchecked, no page opened) electorate-of-brandenburg -> holy-roman-empire-minor-states constituent closes 1618 and no row follows for brandenburg-prussia (1618-1701), whose Brandenburg part (86 cells in 1619) is then drawn direct; the orchestrator may check whether a constituent row is wanted.
